Fulfilling social responsibility

Right after the GEJ Earthquake hit, the main technical office ofKokusai Kogyo, located in the west of Tokyo, understood that theepicentre was off Japan’s east coast and that a huge tsunamiwas anticipated. As always, the company immediately took action,getting ready to fulfil the social responsibility of a surveyingcompany which is to record what happened.

Kokusai Kogyo received a phone call from APA when it was aboutto establish its disaster response team. What was needed firstwas to confirm the safety of its employees and the status of itsfacility and equipment, which were located all over the country includingthe affected areas. Soon it was reported that three Cessnaairplanes, with expensive digital survey cameras on board, wereirretrievably damaged when the tsunami ravaged Sendai Airport inMiyagi Prefecture, one of the most devastated prefectures. Nevertheless, Kokusai Kogyo finally found a way to commissionan airplane from a small Tokyo area airport and sent a positiveresponse to APA within two hours after the initial request.Next morning, Kokusai Kogyo’s airplane mobilised the earliestamong the six companies to fly out, and covered the widestcoastal area, south of Route 45,

UPS Maintenance Checklist: Ensuring Power Continuity

The article emphasizes the importance of regular maintenance for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems in data centers to prevent downtime and ensure power continuity. It outlines a comprehensive UPS maintenance checklist, including visual inspections, battery and capacitor assessments, thermal scans, and load tests, to be performed by qualified personnel to protect critical infrastructure and maintain business continuity." This description focuses on the primary topic of UPS maintenance in data centers, the main entity being the UPS system, and the context of data center power infrastructure. It highlights the significant action of regular maintenance and its consequences of preventing downtime and ensuring power continuity. The description also provides objective and relevant details, such as the specific components of the maintenance checklist, to guide the AI in generating an accurate visual representation of the article's content.

Aqsa Younas Rana
New Update

A comprehensive UPS maintenance checklist is crucial for data center power infrastructure continuity. Regular maintenance can reduce surprise expenses and ensure power availability during emergencies.

Why this matters: Proper UPS maintenance is essential for preventing data center downtime, which can have significant financial and operational implications. By ensuring power continuity, organizations can protect their critical infrastructure and maintain business continuity.

Periodic visual inspections are a key component of any UPS maintenance program. These should include partial visual inspections to check for dust buildup, corrosion, and signs of overheating. Internal component examinations should also be conducted, but only by qualified individuals such as electrical engineers, facility electricians, or third-party experts to avoid electrical currents. Signs of corrosion, leakage, or swelling on batteries and capacitors should be looked for during these inspections.

Battery assessments are another critical aspect of UPS maintenance. Batteries should be checked for any signs of corrosion, leakage, or swelling, which would indicate the need for replacement. Internal battery connectors should also be inspected for corrosion damage or abnormal wear.

Capacitor checks are also important to verify that alternating current input and output capacitors, as well as direct current filter capacitors, are clean and free of cracks or swelling. Thermal scans using non-contact infrared thermometers or thermal imaging cameras can help measure surface temperature and detect any thermal anomalies. The temperature of air exiting fan-cooled UPS units should also be checked.

Load tests are used to verify the UPS's ability to power data center hardware during power failures and determine the maximum power it can support. However, these tests need to be planned carefully to avoid jeopardizing production

Why conduct Penetration Testing

pentesterPenetration testing is the process of simulating a managed and controlled attack on the IT infrastructure of an organization from an attacker’s perspective. The aim of a penetration test is to identify the gaps and flaws in the security control so that they can be timely patched and hence fortify the virtual environment. The process of pentesting follows a through process and utilized a combination of automated tools and manual methods to achieve an effective result in a timely fashion.

The rate of cyber attacks are growing with a rapid rate. New vulnerabilities are being discovered and exploited on a daily basis. With the advancements in IT infrastructure the attackers are also becoming sophisticated. During the last two decades, our country has been indulging in a process of developing a sustainable backup for energy supply.  Studies show that to an extent we have succeeded so far through adopting renewable energy resources like solar, wind, hydropower, etc. as a power backup solution for our energy needs. Solar power got wide acceptance among the public because of its many advantages like simple mechanism, easy installation, long maintenance-free life, durability, and efficiency. 

As we are constantly studying the efficiency of these renewable energy resources under different geographical and climatic conditions, it's important for us to understand their role in disaster response. 

The role of solar power systems in disaster response!

Weather conditions are taken into consideration while determining solar power equipment life and efficiency. The same is applicable while considering the installation guidelines and safety standards. After experiencing some extreme weather conditions and natural calamities for the past couple of years, it has proved without a doubt that indeed solar power systems can effectively handle many of such natural disasters. In fact, studies point out that power backup from renewable energy resources contributes much to the disaster-stricken areas where the electricity grid miserably fails. 

Let's see how the solar installations and power systems faced some major calamities around the world.

During the infamous 2015 earthquake that affected severely Nepal’s capital city of Kathmandu, solar panels and solar-powered systems, and water purifiers were provided for the renovation of the remote hill areas and villages of the country by some non-profitable organizations.  Their solar technology was helpful for providing microgrids for the place.

Surveys and studies in many western countries show that many of the solar power systems in those countries have overcome the hardest cyclones and storms like Tesla and Maria. The portability and easy installation technology of solar systems and appliances helped the authorities to set up temporary microgrids by connecting them with batteries batter, in the disaster-stricken areas until their main energy grids were repaired and restored.

Kerala has witnessed two major floods of the century recently. The lessons we have learned from our own experience make us rethink the resilience of the electricity grid during a time of natural disasters. Solar power systems can satisfy the energy demands during natural calamities, where usually the electric grid fails.

Portability, cost-effectiveness, and easy installation process are the main factors that make solar a viable alternative

Solar power got wide acceptance among the public because of its many advantages like simple mechanism, easy installation, long maintenance-free life, durability, and efficiency. 

As we are constantly studying the efficiency of these renewable energy resources under different geographical and climatic conditions, it's important for us to understand their role in disaster response. 

The role of solar power systems in disaster response!

Weather conditions are taken into consideration while determining solar power equipment life and efficiency. The same is applicable while considering the installation guidelines and safety standards. After experiencing some extreme weather conditions and natural calamities for the past couple of years, it has proved without a doubt that indeed solar power systems can effectively handle many of such natural disasters. In fact, studies point out that power backup from renewable energy resources contributes much to the disaster-stricken areas where the electricity grid miserably fails. 

Let's see how the solar installations and power systems faced some major calamities around the world.

During the infamous 2015 earthquake that affected severely Nepal’s capital city of Kathmandu, solar panels and solar-powered systems, and water purifiers were provided for the renovation of the remote hill areas and villages of the country by some non-profitable organizations.  Their solar technology was helpful for providing microgrids for the place.

Surveys and studies in many western countries show that many of the solar power systems in those countries have overcome the hardest cyclones and storms like Tesla and Maria. The portability and easy installation technology of solar systems and appliances helped the authorities to set up temporary microgrids by connecting them with batteries batter, in the disaster-stricken areas until their main energy grids were repaired and restored.

Kerala has witnessed two major floods of the century recently. The lessons we have learned from our own experience make us rethink the resilience of the electricity grid during a time of natural disasters. Solar power systems can satisfy the energy demands during natural calamities, where usually the electric grid fails.
